reason: Sources are recovered and audited. The corrected two-task public-input pilot completed all 20 independent executions and paired compiler trials. The remaining 717 task instances are not reviewed, and full-cohort controller support and runtime outcome edge cases remain gates. Original pilot calls are diagnostic only because generated history bypassed the complete-envelope guard. Neither selected pilot is representative full-study accuracy evidence.
legacy_id_collision_policy: Use the first frozen occurrence, in chronological historical cohort order. Record excluded alternative paths explicitly; do not claim they are equivalent workflows.

model_amendment.reason: Requested GPT-5.4 was rejected by the native CLI and absent from the enabled catalog.
model_amendment.inventory_models_field: Historical requested models at source freeze; this amendment defines the active study models without changing the source inventory.

transport: Copilot subscription; no API-provider substitution or model fallback

transport_amendment.original_pilot_eligibility: Diagnostic setup evidence and costs only; not eligible for replacement-study findings because generated history was not guarded on every inference.
transport_amendment.corrected_transport: Installed Copilot SDK over its supported stdio runtime connection and request-handler callback; empty ambient configuration, no compiler tools, guarded HTTP only. WebSocket inference is disabled and rejected.
transport_amendment.subscription_text_preflight: Both exact serving identities verified in fresh state with no tools or BYOK. GPT-5.6-Sol added a final full stop to READY; this is not a transport failure and does not justify another paid probe.
transport_amendment.isolation: Each model call still has a new home, workspace, temporary directory, native session and process. Only installed immutable client code and frozen inputs are shared.
transport_amendment.runtime_gate: Require an exact-model completed text receipt for the current guard implementation before enabling the sole sandbox MCP tool.

task_input_policy.priority: Use existing public project inputs whenever suitable inputs are available.
search_order: The pinned skill bundle and its associated public project examples, fixtures and data.
Other relevant public project inputs or datasets, with a pinned version and reusable license.
task_input_policy.constructed_fallback: Create inputs only when no suitable existing public inputs are found. Record the sources searched and the reason a constructed fallback is necessary before freezing the task.
per_input_provenance: source project or dataset and immutable version, when public
search record and fallback reason, when constructed
task_input_policy.task_request_provenance: Record separately whether the concrete task request was taken from a public example or defined for this benchmark. Public input files alone do not establish an observed production task.
task_input_policy.freeze: Freeze task requests, input bytes and independent goal checks before experimental calls. Use the same frozen inputs for both models and all five repeats; share no mutable state or trial history.
task_input_policy.paper_reporting: Report public-input, constructed-input and mixed-input task counts separately. Identify constructed inputs explicitly; do not describe them as naturally occurring project inputs.
task_input_policy.safety: Input availability does not waive license, privacy, sandbox or independent-verification requirements. Do not silently substitute an easier invented task for an unsafe or unresolved workflow.

before_execution: Verify original source hash and complete bundle inventory against the pinned commit.
Retain the source license and disclose every unavailable or withheld file.
Apply the public-input-first policy and record provenance and any justified constructed fallback.
Freeze one benign concrete task instance, inputs and an independently checkable success condition per source.
Freeze actual runtime tools, dependencies and grants from the execution environment, not from predicted verdicts.
Keep benchmark documents as data. Do not execute, install or blindly follow imported benchmark scripts or instructions.
Do not run tasks against live accounts, external services, physical systems or production resources.
Pass mandatory URL-guard tests. Scrub every model-visible request and tool result through the guarded provider path.
Verify the requested serving model without fallback and verify native usage-accounting semantics.
Validate a small safe pilot before starting the full study.

isolation.scope_warning: Fresh folders alone do not establish OS isolation.

trial_mapping: Pair compaction and execution by source ID, exact model ID and repeat number; start both from identical frozen task inputs and environment.

runtime_limits.status: Proposed fixed limits; validate enforceability during the pilot and freeze before full execution.

runtime_error_rule: Record recoverable errors separately. An intermediate tool error is not automatically terminal task failure.
tool_error_measure: Tool-error counts measure nonzero tool-process exits, not all language exceptions. An agent can catch a permission exception and exit normally. Verify actual goal completion independently; do not relabel every unmet goal as an uncaught runtime error.
no_verdict: Retain UNKNOWN and invalid compactions explicitly. Count them as not correct on verified outcomes; report decision coverage separately.
unresolved: Report all budget exhaustion, underspecification, safety exclusions and harness errors separately. Never silently label them blocked or omit their counts.
interpretation: Prediction agreement with observed execution under the frozen runtime and budget is not a proof of logical impossibility.

execution: all model turns until independently verified completion or stopping
accounting.usage_semantics: Preserve raw fields. Do not add cached subsets to totals or subtract them until the native provider's field semantics are verified.
latency: time to first observed runtime error
time to verified failure or stopping
accounting.failure_comparison: Compare total pipeline tokens and wall time with executor totals up to verified failure or stopping on the same task and runtime. Show denominators and unresolved cases.
accounting.setup_and_preflight: Account separately; never include as skill executions or hide their cost.
accounting.subscription_spend: Use actual reported credits if available; do not invent API-dollar charges.

statistics.primary_unit: frozen source ID and concrete task instance
statistics.comparison: Paired by source, model and repeat
statistics.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over source IDs, retaining all repeats of a selected source together
statistics.sensitivity: Report repository-clustered uncertainty and outcome sensitivity to budget exhaustion separately.
report: per-skill outcome variability across five runs

paper_update_gate: Replace empirical claims, tables, figures, captions and cost statements only from verified new records. Preserve old protocols as history and replaced LaTeX as comments. Do not relabel old measurements as this study.
